messages:
alex: kicking off NA-central cluster bring-up (na-central-g2). high-level: bootstrap gitops, mirror images to our na registry, apply helm chart overrides for dedicated-gpu nodepools, run smoke + perf validation, then handoff to region-oncall. looking for checklist + owners :eyes:
maria: nice. can you paste the expected registry path and replication window? also any constraints on node taints/labels?
dan: registry plan: mirror from artifacts.redwood.ai -> na.gcr.redwood.io/rdi/na-central. replication job runs hourly, with backfill for last 7 days. permissions: robot-sa with read-only on upstream, write on na registry. sample config: ```yaml
replicator:
  source: artifacts.redwood.ai/rdi
  target: na.gcr.redwood.io/rdi/na-central
  schedule: "0 * * * *"
  backfill_days: 7
```
olivia: cost note: prefer spot-backed A100/RTX pools for batch workloads; keep a small on-demand reserve (2 nodes) for latency-critical inference. estimate: ~0.35c/hr per GPU on spot, reserve adds ~$1k/mo. need approval from finance for > $20k commit.
jin: helm overrides to use dedicated nodepool + taints: ```yaml
nodeSelector:
  nodepool: rdi-gpu-na
 tolerations:
- key: "dedicated"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "inference"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```
Also create Flux kustomization in infra-apps repo: `flux create kustomization na-central --source=gitops-repo --path="./clusters/na-central" --prune=true --interval=1m`
sre-bot: [deploy-bot] flux kustomization "na-central" created by jin. reconciliation scheduled.
alex: thanks. validation checklist draft: 1) GitOps manifests reconcile (flux) 2) all helm releases healthy (`kubectl -n infra get deploy,sts`) 3) nodepools ready with GPUs visible (`kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=rdi-gpu-na -o wide`) 4) container image pull test from na registry 5) simple GPU scheduling smoke: run cuda-sample job 6) networking check: calico BGP peers + service LB annotations 7) perf smoke: 99th p95 token latency with small model container 8) cost guardrails: set autoscaler min/max and quota alerts
maria: for step 4, image pull test command: `kubectl run imgtest --image=na.gcr.redwood.io/rdi/hello-gpu:sha123 --rm -it --restart=Never --labels=test=img` — if it starts, registry works.
dan: for step 5, cuda job: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: cuda-smoke
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cuda
        image: na.gcr.redwood.io/rdi/cuda-samples:11.8
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","nvidia-smi && python run_sample.py"]
      restartPolicy: Never
EOF`
jin: networking gotcha — cloud provider assigns internal LB range that differs from prod eu ranges; make sure external CIDR and firewall rules added to infra repo (clusters/na-central/networking.yaml) else kube-proxy health fails.
olivia: also flag: quota on regional GPUs is 120 by default. to hit 200 we need quota request ticket (link: https://cloud.portal/quotas). file ticket now if we expect >120 before handoff.
alex: handoff plan: once all checks pass, tag release `na-central/ready` in gitops-repo, ping #oncall-region-na with checklist, assign owner to region-oncall (rotation: dan this week). include runbook link and rollback steps (reconcile revert + delete kustomization).
dan: noted. i'll open the quota ticket and start registry mirroring. assigning tasks: dan=registry+quota, jin=gitops kustomization+helm overrides, maria=validation scripts, olivia=cost approvals/estimates. alex=overall signoff.
sre-bot: [incident-bot] scheduled maintenance window 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC for na region networking changes.
alex: FYI — keep the maintenance window in sync with agora infra window. final ask: please post short results in this thread as you complete each checklist item. :thumbsup:
